This wand of lacquered black wood has a handle wrapped in interwoven colorful ribbons. A silver bell caps the wand’s tasseled pommel.

**Activate** <actions string="" /> Cast a Spell;  **Frequency** once per day, plus overcharge;   **Effect** You Cast the Spell.

**Activate** <actions string="" /> Interact ([emotion](/Traits.aspx?ID=590), [illusion](/Traits.aspx?ID=629), [light](/Traits.aspx?ID=640), [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=647), [visual](/Traits.aspx?ID=727))   **Requirements** The last action you took this turn was to Cast a Spell from the wand; **Effect** You make yourself the center of attention. An illusory spotlight shines [bright light](/Rules.aspx?ID=2402) upon your space as you pull inane objects from the wand's tip, such as confetti, silk flowers, streamers, or a long string of colorful kerchiefs knotted end to end. Each enemy within 30 feet must attempt a Will save against your spell DC, receiving a +4 circumstance bonus to the save if you or any of your allies recently threatened it or used hostile actions against it. On a failure, the creature becomes [fascinated](/Conditions.aspx?ID=72) with you until the end of your next turn. The fascination ends if the target is subject to a [hostile act](/Rules.aspx?ID=2251), or if another creature succeeds at a [Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=39) or [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=40) check against it.

The spotlight follows you wherever you move. You can't be [concealed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=62) while in the spotlight. The effect ends if you become [invisible](/Conditions.aspx?ID=83), attempt a [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=48) check, or [Dismiss](/Actions.aspx?ID=2311) the activation.

You can [Sustain](/Actions.aspx?ID=2631) this Activation for up to 1 minute. Since you need to keep performing tricks, Sustain an Activation has the [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645) trait. Sustaining extends the spotlight, and keeps fascinated creatures fascinated, but doesn't cause creatures not already fascinated to become fascinated.

**Craft Requirements** Supply a casting of a spell of the appropriate level.

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This wand of lacquered black wood has a handle wrapped in interwoven colorful ribbons. A silver bell caps the wand’s tasseled pommel.

**Activate** <actions string="" /> Cast a Spell;  **Frequency** once per day, plus overcharge;   **Effect** You Cast the Spell.

**Activate** <actions string="" /> Interact ([emotion](/Traits.aspx?ID=590), [illusion](/Traits.aspx?ID=629), [light](/Traits.aspx?ID=640), [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=647), [visual](/Traits.aspx?ID=727))   **Requirements** The last action you took this turn was to Cast a Spell from the wand; **Effect** You make yourself the center of attention. An illusory spotlight shines [bright light](/Rules.aspx?ID=2402) upon your space as you pull inane objects from the wand's tip, such as confetti, silk flowers, streamers, or a long string of colorful kerchiefs knotted end to end. Each enemy within 30 feet must attempt a Will save against your spell DC, receiving a +4 circumstance bonus to the save if you or any of your allies recently threatened it or used hostile actions against it. On a failure, the creature becomes [fascinated](/Conditions.aspx?ID=72) with you until the end of your next turn. The fascination ends if the target is subject to a [hostile act](/Rules.aspx?ID=2251), or if another creature succeeds at a [Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=39) or [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=40) check against it.

The spotlight follows you wherever you move. You can't be [concealed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=62) while in the spotlight. The effect ends if you become [invisible](/Conditions.aspx?ID=83), attempt a [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=48) check, or [Dismiss](/Actions.aspx?ID=2311) the activation.

You can [Sustain](/Actions.aspx?ID=2631) this Activation for up to 1 minute. Since you need to keep performing tricks, Sustain an Activation has the [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645) trait. Sustaining extends the spotlight, and keeps fascinated creatures fascinated, but doesn't cause creatures not already fascinated to become fascinated.

**Craft Requirements** Supply a casting of a spell of the appropriate level.

---

This wand of lacquered black wood has a handle wrapped in interwoven colorful ribbons. A silver bell caps the wand's tasseled pommel.

**Activate** <actions string="" /> Cast a Spell;  **Frequency** once per day, plus overcharge;   **Effect** You Cast the Spell.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> Interact ([emotion](/Traits.aspx?ID=60), [illusion](/Traits.aspx?ID=92), [light](/Traits.aspx?ID=100), [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=106), [visual](/Traits.aspx?ID=163))   **Requirements** The last action you took this turn was to Cast a Spell from the wand; **Effect** You make yourself the center of attention. An illusory spotlight shines [bright light](/Rules.aspx?ID=407) upon your space as you pull inane objects from the wand's tip, such as confetti, silk flowers, streamers, or a long string of colorful kerchiefs knotted end to end. Each enemy within 30 feet must attempt a Will save against your spell DC, receiving a +4 circumstance bonus to the save if you or any of your allies recently threatened it or used [hostile actions](/Rules.aspx?ID=300) against it. On a failure, the creature becomes [fascinated](/Conditions.aspx?ID=14) with you until the end of your next turn. The fascination ends if the target is subject to a hostile act, or if another creature succeeds at a [Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=6) or [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=7) check against it.

 The spotlight follows you wherever you move. You can't be [concealed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=4) while in the spotlight. The effect ends if you become [invisible](/Conditions.aspx?ID=26), attempt a [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=15) check, or Dismiss the activation.

 You can Sustain this Activation for up to 1 minute. Since you need to keep performing tricks, Sustain an Activation has the [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104) trait. Sustaining extends the spotlight, and keeps fascinated creatures fascinated, but doesn't cause creatures not already fascinated to become fascinated.

**Craft Requirements** Supply a casting of a spell of the appropriate rank.

---

This wand of lacquered black wood has a handle wrapped in interwoven colorful ribbons. A silver bell caps the wand’s tasseled pommel.

**Activate** <actions string="" /> Cast a Spell;  **Frequency** once per day, plus overcharge;   **Effect** You Cast the Spell.

**Activate** <actions string="" /> Interact ([emotion](/Traits.aspx?ID=590), [illusion](/Traits.aspx?ID=629), [light](/Traits.aspx?ID=640), [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=647), [visual](/Traits.aspx?ID=727))   **Requirements** The last action you took this turn was to Cast a Spell from the wand; **Effect** You make yourself the center of attention. An illusory spotlight shines [bright light](/Rules.aspx?ID=2402) upon your space as you pull inane objects from the wand's tip, such as confetti, silk flowers, streamers, or a long string of colorful kerchiefs knotted end to end. Each enemy within 30 feet must attempt a Will save against your spell DC, receiving a +4 circumstance bonus to the save if you or any of your allies recently threatened it or used hostile actions against it. On a failure, the creature becomes [fascinated](/Conditions.aspx?ID=72) with you until the end of your next turn. The fascination ends if the target is subject to a [hostile act](/Rules.aspx?ID=2251), or if another creature succeeds at a [Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=39) or [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=40) check against it.

The spotlight follows you wherever you move. You can't be [concealed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=62) while in the spotlight. The effect ends if you become [invisible](/Conditions.aspx?ID=83), attempt a [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=48) check, or [Dismiss](/Actions.aspx?ID=2311) the activation.

You can [Sustain](/Actions.aspx?ID=2631) this Activation for up to 1 minute. Since you need to keep performing tricks, Sustain an Activation has the [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645) trait. Sustaining extends the spotlight, and keeps fascinated creatures fascinated, but doesn't cause creatures not already fascinated to become fascinated.

**Craft Requirements** Supply a casting of a spell of the appropriate level.

</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />

<column gap="tiny">

---

This wand of lacquered black wood has a handle wrapped in interwoven colorful ribbons. A silver bell caps the wand's tasseled pommel.

**Activate** <actions string="" /> Cast a Spell;  **Frequency** once per day, plus overcharge;   **Effect** You Cast the Spell.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> Interact ([emotion](/Traits.aspx?ID=60), [illusion](/Traits.aspx?ID=92), [light](/Traits.aspx?ID=100), [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=106), [visual](/Traits.aspx?ID=163))   **Requirements** The last action you took this turn was to Cast a Spell from the wand; **Effect** You make yourself the center of attention. An illusory spotlight shines [bright light](/Rules.aspx?ID=407) upon your space as you pull inane objects from the wand's tip, such as confetti, silk flowers, streamers, or a long string of colorful kerchiefs knotted end to end. Each enemy within 30 feet must attempt a Will save against your spell DC, receiving a +4 circumstance bonus to the save if you or any of your allies recently threatened it or used [hostile actions](/Rules.aspx?ID=300) against it. On a failure, the creature becomes [fascinated](/Conditions.aspx?ID=14) with you until the end of your next turn. The fascination ends if the target is subject to a hostile act, or if another creature succeeds at a [Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=6) or [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=7) check against it.

 The spotlight follows you wherever you move. You can't be [concealed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=4) while in the spotlight. The effect ends if you become [invisible](/Conditions.aspx?ID=26), attempt a [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=15) check, or Dismiss the activation.

 You can Sustain this Activation for up to 1 minute. Since you need to keep performing tricks, Sustain an Activation has the [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104) trait. Sustaining extends the spotlight, and keeps fascinated creatures fascinated, but doesn't cause creatures not already fascinated to become fascinated.

**Craft Requirements** Supply a casting of a spell of the appropriate rank.

**Bulk** L

---

This wand features a carved dragon’s head at its top and a polished metal sphere set in its midsection.

**Activate** <actions string="" /> Cast a Spell;  **Frequency** once per day, plus overcharge;   **Effect** You cast [_magic missile_](/Spells.aspx?ID=180) of the indicated level. After you cast the spell, an additional missile or missiles are released from the wand at the start of each of your turns, as though you cast the 1-action version of _magic missile_. Choose targets each time. This lasts for 1 minute, until you’re no longer wielding the wand, or until you try to activate the wand again.

**Craft Requirements** Supply a casting of _magic missile_ of the appropriate level.

The pommel of this rose quartz wand resembles the stylized wings of an [angel](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=359). When you cast its spell and choose not to make it [nonlethal](/Traits.aspx?ID=661), the crystal deepens to blood red. The color reverts to rose when you cast the spell from the wand nonlethally.

**Craft Requirements** Supply a casting of a spell of the appropriate level. The spell must have a casting time of <actions string="Single Action" /> or <actions string="Two Actions" />, it must deal damage, and it can’t have the [death](/Traits.aspx?ID=571), negative, or [nonlethal](/Traits.aspx?ID=661) traits.

The pommel of this rose quartz wand resembles the stylized wings of an [angel](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=359). **Craft Requirements** Supply a casting of a spell of the appropriate level. The spell must have a casting time of <actions string="Single Action" /> or <actions string="Two Actions" />, it must deal damage, and it can’t have the [death](/Traits.aspx?ID=571), negative, or [nonlethal](/Traits.aspx?ID=661) traits.

<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 6+"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Wand of Purification](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3476)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=644" />
<trait label="Wand" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=731" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Tian Xia Character Guide](/Sources.aspx?ID=230) pg. 130

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This cypress onusa rod is decorated with a number of paper streamers that rustle when shaken to direct purification magic. Wands of purification contain either [_cleanse affliction_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1467), [_clear mind_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1469), or [_sound body_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1679), decided when the wand is created.

**Activate** <actions string="" /> Cast a Spell;  **Frequency** once per day, plus overcharge;   **Effect** You cast cleanse affliction, clear mind, or sound body of the indicated level. If your [counteract](/Rules.aspx?ID=2250) check would be sufficient only to suppress the effect until the beginning of your next turn, instead of to fully counteract it, then you can [Sustain](/Actions.aspx?ID=2317) the Activation of the wand each round to suppress the effect for an additional round, to a maximum of 1 minute. You Sustain the Activation by shaking the wand, so if at any point you release or otherwise drop the wand, the effect immediately stops being suppressed and resumes on the target as normal.

Wands of purification contain either cleanse affliction , clear mind , or sound body , decided when the wand is created. Activate Cast a Spell; Frequency once per day, plus overcharge; Effect You cast cleanse affliction, clear mind, or sound body of the indicated level. If your counteract check would be sufficient only to suppress the effect until the beginning of your next turn, instead of to fully counteract it, then you can Sustain the Activation of the wand each round to suppress the effect for an additional round, to a maximum of 1 minute. You Sustain the Activation by shaking the wand, so if at any point you release or otherwise drop the wand, the effect immediately stops being suppressed and resumes on the target as normal. </title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Light" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=100" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
<trait label="Wand" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=164" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 142

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This wand is short and wide with a hexagonal, crystal shaft and a leather-wrapped handle. The wand refracts direct bright light into a rainbow.

**Activate** <actions string="" /> Cast a Spell;  **Frequency** once per day, plus overcharge;   **Effect** You cast [_chromatic ray_](/Spells.aspx?ID=883) of the indicated rank. After you cast the spell, if you hit the target, the light refracts to another creature within 30 feet of the first target. Roll your spell attack roll and to determine the ray's color separately for each target. The ray continues to refract each time it hits. The refraction ceases if you miss any target, and you can end the refraction at any point. You can't target the same creature more than once, and you must have line of effect to all targets.

**Craft Requirements** Supply a casting of _chromatic ray_ of the appropriate rank.

</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Fire" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=72" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
<trait label="Wand" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=164" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 142

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

The luminous design of red-orange cracks on this black obsidian wand suggests cooling lava.

**Activate** <actions string="" /> Cast a Spell;  **Frequency** once per day, plus overcharge;   **Effect** You cast [_floating flame_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1533) of the indicated rank. If you create the flame on the ground, the ground in the sphere’s square and all adjacent squares are coated in rolling flames until the start of your next turn. These are [difficult terrain](/Rules.aspx?ID=2366) and [hazardous terrain](/Rules.aspx?ID=2368). A creature that moves on the ground takes fire damage for every square of rolling flames it moves into, with the amount determined by the wand’s type. If a creature in the flames doesn’t move on its turn, it takes the damage for each of the squares it’s in at the end of its turn. The first time you [Sustain the Spell](/Actions.aspx?ID=2631) each round, the sphere creates rolling flames again in its new location (or the same location if you chose not to move it), provided it’s on the ground.

**Craft Requirements** Supply a casting of _floating flame_ of the appropriate rank.

</column>

---

The luminous design of red-orange cracks on this black obsidian wand suggests cooling lava.

**Activate** <actions string="" /> Cast a Spell;  **Frequency** once per day, plus overcharge;   **Effect** You cast [_flaming sphere_](/Spells.aspx?ID=121) of the indicated level. The ground in the sphere's square and all adjacent squares are coated in rolling flames until the start of your next turn. These are [difficult terrain](/Rules.aspx?ID=2366) and [hazardous terrain](/Rules.aspx?ID=2368). A creature that moves on the ground takes fire damage for every square of rolling flames it moves into, with the amount determined by the wand's type. If a creature in the flames doesn't move on its turn, it takes the damage for each of the squares it's in at the end of its turn. The first time you [Sustain](/Actions.aspx?ID=2317) the Spell each round, the sphere creates rolling flames again in its new location (or the same location if you chose not to move it).

**Craft Requirements** Supply a casting of [_flaming sphere_](/Spells.aspx?ID=121) of the appropriate level.

---

The luminous design of red-orange cracks on this black obsidian wand suggests cooling lava.

**Activate** <actions string="" /> Cast a Spell;  **Frequency** once per day, plus overcharge;   **Effect** You cast [_flaming sphere_](/Spells.aspx?ID=121) of the indicated level. The ground in the sphere's square and all adjacent squares are coated in rolling flames until the start of your next turn. These are [difficult terrain](/Rules.aspx?ID=2366) and [hazardous terrain](/Rules.aspx?ID=2368). A creature that moves on the ground takes fire damage for every square of rolling flames it moves into, with the amount determined by the wand's type. If a creature in the flames doesn't move on its turn, it takes the damage for each of the squares it's in at the end of its turn. The first time you [Sustain](/Actions.aspx?ID=2317) the Spell each round, the sphere creates rolling flames again in its new location (or the same location if you chose not to move it).

**Craft Requirements** Supply a casting of [_flaming sphere_](/Spells.aspx?ID=121) of the appropriate level.

Shattered pieces of a glass mirror, formed into a reflective mosaic, comprise the irregular shaft of this wand. The handle is black and polished smooth, the pommel capped with a tiny reflective orb.

**Activate** <actions string="" /> Cast a Spell;  **Frequency** once per day, plus overcharge;   **Effect** You cast [_mirror image_](/Spells.aspx?ID=197). Each time an image is destroyed, the image shatters into sharp fragments of glass. If the creature that destroyed the image is adjacent to you, it takes 5 slashing damage.

**Craft Requirements** Supply a casting of [_mirror image_](/Spells.aspx?ID=197).

When you move this delicately carved poplar wand, it looks indistinct, leaving a trail of afterimages in its wake.

**Activate** <actions string="" /> Cast a Spell;  **Frequency** once per day, plus overcharge;   **Effect** You cast [_fleet step_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1531). For the duration of the spell, you’re also [concealed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=62) while you [Stride](/Actions.aspx?ID=2305).

**Craft Requirements** Supply a casting of [_fleet step_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1531).

---

This polished black wand has a green gem at the tip, and anyone who looks into it sees a reflection of a grinning skull.

**Activate** <actions string="" /> Cast a Spell;  **Frequency** once per day, plus overcharge;   **Effect** You cast [_execute_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1519) at the indicated rank. If the spell slays a living target, the corpse releases grim energy in a 20-foot emanation, dealing void damage equal to double the spell's rank.

**Craft Requirements** Supply a casting of [_execute_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1519) of the appropriate rank.

---

This wooden wand is roughly cut, as if it had been crudely chopped from a tree and left forgotten. When held, the wand imparts feelings of deep sorrow. 

**Activate** <actions string="" /> Cast a Spell;  **Frequency** once per day plus overcharge;   **Effect** You cast [_splinter volley_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1410) of the indicated rank. Each splinter contains some of the despair felt by cruelly harvested trees, causing any creature damaged by this spell to become stupefied 2 for a number of rounds equal to the spell rank. On a critical success on the attack roll, the target also weeps, becoming [slowed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=92) 1 for the same duration.

**Craft Requirements** Supply a casting of _splinter volley_ of the appropriate level.

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This pale wooden wand is carved to resemble a thigh bone with metal caps at each end. Ghostly tendrils seem to swirl around it every so often.

**Activate** <actions string="" /> Cast a Spell;  **Frequency** once per day, plus overcharge;   **Effect** You cast [_false vitality_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1523) of the indicated rank. During the duration of the spell, wisps that resemble spirits flit around you as long as you have any temporary Hit Points from _false vitality_, and you can use the following action.

**Activate** <actions string="Free Action" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561))  **Trigger** You successfully impart the [frightened 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=19) condition on a creature; **Requirements** You have at least 1 temporary Hit Point from _false vitality_; **Effect** You end _false vitality_ and increase the creature's frightened condition value to 2.

**Craft Requirements** Supply a casting of _false vitality_ of the appropriate rank.

<row gap="medium">

---

This pale wooden wand is carved to resemble a thigh bone with metal caps at each end. Ghostly tendrils seem to swirl around it every so often.

**Activate** <actions string="" /> Cast a Spell;  **Frequency** once per day, plus overcharge;   **Effect** You cast [_false life_](/Spells.aspx?ID=108) of the indicated level. During the duration of the spell, wisps that resemble spirits flit around you as long as you have any [temporary Hit Points](/Rules.aspx?ID=2321) from _false life_, and you can use the following action.

**Activate** <actions string="Free Action" /> envision;   **Trigger** You successfully impart the [frightened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=76) 1 condition on a creature; **Requirements** You have at least 1 [temporary Hit Point](/Rules.aspx?ID=2321) from _false life_; **Effect** You end _false life_ and increase the creature’s frightened condition value to 2.

**Craft Requirements** Supply a casting of [_false life_](/Spells.aspx?ID=108) of the appropriate level.
